description:
Role: SQL BI Developer
Location: Clearfield, Utah
Duration: 6+ Months

BGV will be done for the selected candidates.

JD:

· 5+ years developing BI reports/dashboards using Microsoft BI/SQL Server technology stack (SSRS, SSIS, SSAS) with data from ERP systems.

· 3+ year of experience leading own projects.

· 3+ year developing ERP interfaces with external systems.

· 3+ year administering servers in a virtualized Windows Server environment.

· Experience with IFS, SAP, or Ross ERP systems preferred but not required. We will train the right person on the necessary knowledge.

· Experience developing with PL/SQL and XML preferred but not required.

· Create Data Warehouses using SSAS cubes, MDX, and Tabular data models.

· Builds data transformations with SSIS including importing data from files, moving data from one database platform to another; builds star schema data marts.

· Collaborates with business analysts, subject matter experts, and other team members to determine data extraction and transformation requirements.

· Gathers business requirements and works with data analysts on physical database design and modeling.

· Performs code reviews, analyzes execution plans, and re-factors inefficient code.

· Follows data standards, resolves data issues, and completes unit testing and system documentation for Extract Transfer Load (ETL) processes.

· Conducts system tests and root cause analysis, troubleshoots issues and corrects database defects, responding quickly to bug fixes and enhancement requests.

· Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services SSAS SSIS, SSRS and Power BI

· Has strong knowledge of relational databases, as well as skills in SQL query design and development.
